label: known or named as
definition: Entity X is explicitly known, named, renamed, or referred to by alternative name Y for the same entity.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit known-as or also-called identity; a stated alias or alternative name; historical renaming of the same entity. Excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity; comparison or resemblance rather than identity; ordinary description without an alternative designation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear referent of the alternative name; an explicitly proposed new name without established use; name versus separate institution when unresolved. The predicate concerns two names or designations of one referent. Do not infer identity from an ownership relationship.

facts.reason: Eagles → Giants: Sporting play, briefings or coaching does not establish two names for the same entity.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
